mechanism.claim: When a completed high-variation BTC eight-hour cycle has price/aggregate aggressive-flow sign agreement under open-interest expansion, or price/flow sign disagreement under open-interest contraction, the aggressive-flow direction identifies respectively sponsored continuation or liquidation absorption; trade that flow direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed aggregate aggressive quote flow
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPFOICR requires an exact completed-range close location with exact OI contraction and variation. No prior composite event set or control is reused; it uses no spot, ETH, funding, premium-index, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour price-flow-OI sign concordance states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, exact and available by D
features.cycle: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D) with positive quote turnover and 0<=taker_buy_quote<=quote turnover
features.price_return: sum of 480 minute ln(close/open) returns, finite strict nonzero
features.state_identity: sign(price_return)*sign(flow_share)==sign(oi_change); expansion requires price-flow agreement and contraction requires disagreement
features.side: sign(flow_share) for both sponsored-continuation and liquidation-absorption states
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute price returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact source-valid cycle, strict nonzero price/flow/OI signs, state_identity true, and variation rank passes

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC, quote_asset_volume, and taker_buy_quote
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint, price-flow-OI identity, variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
